fixtures.purpose: Real dependency metadata; large nested package graph object.
Real application/development configuration; medium nested object.
Established upstream benchmark fixture; array of API-shaped records. Mock fixture, not a captured production response.
Actual JSONPlaceholder public API service backing data; fictional posts/comments/albums/photos/todos/users. Large arrays and nested API records, not private user information.

limitations: Local serial child processes, randomly shuffled order per run; uncontrolled CPU placement, OS scheduling, thermal state, power mode and GC.
RSS includes fixture loading/JSON parsing/native require/warmup. No serializer-only peak or allocation count.
Text cases include full public wrapper validation, napi UTF conversion, native processing and returned JS string. Input text prepared before timing. JS baselines parse and sort each operation.
Source fixtures preserve formatting and token spelling; exact result comparisons establish fixture-specific equivalence only. General text semantics differ.
Batch methods include identical JSON.stringify of returned array. Cache hits skip serialization under explicit caller version contract.
